The 13 June ORB line says "'A' Party, No 129 Wing Departed RAF Odiham for the Concentration Area (Old Sarum)", but the last recorded station move is Odiham to Westhampnett on 22-24 April and the narrative history places the 12 May redesignation at Westhampnett. No return to Odiham is recorded, so no Odiham claim is entered. Old Sarum is not treated as a home base. The Airlift Party went to Holmsley South on 16 June (staging, not entered as the wing headquarters station).
